explanation: The proof uses the project’s own `BalancedTensorProduct.lift_tmul`. Mathlib has `TensorProduct.lift_tmul` in `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/TensorProduct/Tower.lean`, but it applies to the distinct commutative-base `TensorProduct`, not this custom balanced tensor product over an arbitrary ring. I found no matching Mathlib, Batteries, or Lean core declaration.
